about_the_game:
Tormentum II is the long-awaited continuation of a dark adventure game inspired by the works of H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński.

The gates to the surreal world of Tormentum open once again - a place filled with grim figures and revolting creatures, as if pulled straight from the worst nightmares. Its hand-drawn art, rooted in the legacy of great painters, is built to deliver a mood that crawls under your skin and stays there.

This time, the adventure begins in the future - in a universe where video games can still bring a little relief to a world left hollow by technology and stripped of hope. You play as a game creator obsessed with doing what no one has ever managed to do: build a world inhabited by characters whose intelligence matches that of a human being.

One day, a mysterious package arrives. Inside: a mysterious processor. Soon, disturbing visions start to haunt him. Reality blends with a dreamlike nightmare, and characters from the game begin to slip into his world. Or maybe it’s the other way around…

He decides to install the processor. From that moment on, nothing is certain — and he becomes a prisoner of his own creation.

He wakes up in a prison on an island surrounded by a vast expanse of water, and begins to explore the world he made. But it isn’t what he imagined: less welcoming, more hostile, more aggressive. And one thing unsettles him more than anything else - the people he meets speak of a god living on one of the most distant islands. A god that was never in his game. A god he did not create.

You’ll uncover a huge, dark world spread across a dozen islands - packed with secrets and strange, varied creatures. To find his way back home and, along the way, track down the mysterious god, the protagonist must cross a sprawling land made up of more than 150 areas - several times more than in the first game.

As you travel, you’ll face choices that test your conscience and force you into decisions that are rarely clear-cut - decisions that shape the fate of the characters you encounter. Because of this, the game isn’t fully linear, and the story can lead to more than one ending, depending on what you choose.

short_description: Tormentum II is a dark, surreal Point & Click adventure where nightmare worlds, grotesque creatures, and uneasy choices await. Inspired by H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński, it’s the long-awaited return to Tormentum.
